construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit T25-013 (Tentative Map, folder year 2025), status Under Review: "Vesting Tentative Map to allow the subdivision of one lot into five residential condominiums on an approximately 0.25-gross-acre site."

City permit GIS: H25-017 Site Development Permit, "construction of (5) 2-story condos with on-site parking with a density bonus waiver for commercial use in the MUC Zoning District, on a 0.25-gross-acre vacant site," applicant De Nguyen, status Inactive. T25-013 and ER25-123 show Under Review. PRE26-238, filed July 2026 by De Nguyen (Speed Construction and Development Inc), proposes 3 detached residential buildings with a total of 6 units and shows Under Review.
MLS listing ML81959920 shows the lot sold for $790,000 as a vacant development site zoned Mixed Use Commercial, listed by Marcus & Millichap; the listing does not show a sale date.
